steps.en: Clone the repo to the path its scripts expect, then run the sync script
steps.zh: 把仓库克隆到脚本写死的路径，再跑同步脚本

steps.en: Links skills/ into Codex whole, and into Claude Code one skill at a time
steps.zh: skills/ 整体链给 Codex，逐个链给 Claude Code

steps.en: Points each agent's global instruction file at the one shared AGENTS.MD
steps.zh: 把各 agent 的全局指令文件指向同一份 AGENTS.MD

steps.en: Start each downstream repo's AGENTS.MD with the pointer line; repo rules go below it
steps.zh: 每个下游仓库的 AGENTS.MD 开头放指针行，本仓库规则写在下面

steps.en: The agent reads the shared rules, then loads a skill when its description matches the task
steps.zh: agent 先读共享规则，任务命中某个 skill 的描述时再加载它

steps.en: Edit a rule or skill once in the repo and push
steps.zh: 规则或 skill 只在本仓库改一次并推送

steps.en: Every linked agent and repo sees the change on its next session, no copies to update
steps.zh: 所有已链接的 agent 与仓库下次会话即生效，没有副本要改

value.en: One edit updates the rules and skills every agent in every repo reads, instead of a dozen drifting copies
value.zh: 改一处，所有仓库里的所有 agent 读到的规则和 skill 都跟着变，不再维护一堆逐渐走样的副本
